mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT partner_id, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM distribution_visit GROUP BY partner_id ) v ON v.partner_id = p.partner_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT partner_id, COUNT(*) AS promoted_user_count FROM distribution_relation GROUP BY partner_id ) r ON r.partner_id = p.partner_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT partner_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status != 'REVERSED' THEN referred_user_id END) AS paid_user_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'REVERSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'REVERSED' THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_amount, SUM(commission_amount - reversed_amount) AS valid_commission_amount FROM distribution_commission GROUP BY partner_id ) c ON c.partner_id = p.partner_id LEFT JOIN distribution_account a ON a.partner_id = p.partner_id

p.partner_id, p.partner_no, p.user_id, u.user_no, u.nick_name, u.avatar_url, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NULL OR u.phone = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phone) <= 7 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4)) END AS phone_masked, p.status, p.enabled_time, p.disabled_time, COALESCE(v.visit_count, 0) AS visit_count, COALESCE(r.promoted_user_count, 0) AS promoted_user_count, COALESCE(c.paid_user_count, 0) AS paid_user_count, COALESCE(c.valid_order_count, 0) AS valid_order_count, COALESCE(c.valid_order_amount, 0) AS valid_order_amount, COALESCE(c.valid_commission_amount, 0) AS valid_commission_amount, COALESCE(a.available_amount, 0) AS available_amount, COALESCE(a.withdraw_locked_amount, 0) AS locked_amount, COALESCE(a.total_withdrawn, 0) AS withdrawn_amount, COALESCE(a.debt_amount, 0) AS debt_amount
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distribution_partner WHERE del_flag = '0') AS partner_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distribution_relation) AS promoted_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT referred_user_id) FROM distribution_commission WHERE status != 'REVERSED') AS paid_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM distribution_commission WHERE status != 'REVERSED') AS valid_order_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_amount), 0) FROM distribution_commission WHERE status != 'REVERSED') AS valid_order_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(commission_amount - reversed_amount), 0) FROM distribution_commission) AS valid_commission_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(available_amount + withdraw_locked_amount), 0) FROM distribution_account) AS unwithdrawn_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_withdrawn), 0) FROM distribution_account) AS withdrawn_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debt_amount), 0) FROM distribution_account) AS debt_amount

SELECT w.withdrawal_id, w.withdrawal_no, w.partner_id, p.partner_no, u.nick_name AS partner_name, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NULL OR u.phone = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phone) <= 7 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4)) END AS phone_masked, w.apply_amount, w.method_type, w.payee_name, w.bank_name, w.bank_account_masked, (w.receipt_qr_file_key IS NOT NULL) AS receipt_available, w.status, w.reject_reason, CASE WHEN w.payment_reference IS NULL OR w.payment_reference = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(w.payment_reference) <= 8 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(w.payment_reference, 4), '****', RIGHT(w.payment_reference, 4)) END AS payment_reference_masked, (w.payment_proof_file_key IS NOT NULL) AS payment_proof_available, w.apply_time, w.audit_time, w.paid_time, w.audit_by, w.pay_by FROM distribution_withdrawal w JOIN distribution_partner p ON p.partner_id = w.partner_id AND p.del_flag = '0' JOIN mobile_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY w.apply_time DESC, w.withdrawal_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM distribution_partner p JOIN mobile_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0'
WHERE p.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY valid_order_amount DESC, valid_commission_amount DESC, p.partner_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_no, u.nick_name, u.avatar_url, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NULL OR u.phone = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phone) <= 7 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4)) END AS phone_masked, (p.partner_id IS NOT NULL) AS already_partner FROM mobile_user u LEFT JOIN distribution_partner p ON p.user_id = u.user_id AND p.del_flag = '0' WHERE u.del_flag = '0'
AND (u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC, u.user_id DESC

SELECT FROM distribution_partner p JOIN mobile_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0'
WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%') AND u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickName}, '%') AND u.user_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userNo}, '%') AND p.partner_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{partnerNo}, '%') AND p.status = #{status} ORDER BY p.create_time DESC, p.partner_id DESC

SELECT , p.invite_code, p.remark, p.create_time FROM distribution_partner p JOIN mobile_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0'
WHERE p.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND p.del_flag = '0'

SELECT r.referred_user_id AS user_id, u.nick_name, u.avatar_url, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NULL OR u.phone = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phone) <= 7 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4)) END AS phone_masked, r.bind_time, COALESCE(c.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(c.order_amount, 0) AS order_amount, COALESCE(c.commission_amount, 0) AS commission_amount FROM distribution_relation r JOIN mobile_user u ON u.user_id = r.referred_user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT referred_user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'REVERSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'REVERSED' THEN order_amount ELSE 0 END) AS order_amount, SUM(commission_amount - reversed_amount) AS commission_amount FROM distribution_commission WHERE partner_id = #{partnerId} GROUP BY referred_user_id ) c ON c.referred_user_id = r.referred_user_id WHERE r.partner_id = #{partnerId} ORDER BY r.bind_time DESC, r.relation_id DESC

SELECT c.commission_id, c.order_no, u.user_no, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NULL OR u.phone = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phone) <= 7 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4)) END AS phone_masked, c.product_type, c.product_name, c.order_amount, c.rate_bps, c.commission_amount, c.status, c.pay_time, c.refund_time FROM distribution_commission c JOIN mobile_user u ON u.user_id = c.referred_user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.partner_id = #{partnerId} ORDER BY c.pay_time DESC, c.commission_id DESC
mapper.sql: c.commission_id, c.order_no, c.partner_id, p.partner_no, pu.nick_name AS partner_name, ou.user_no, CASE WHEN ou.phone IS NULL OR ou.phone = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(ou.phone) <= 7 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(ou.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(ou.phone, 4)) END AS phone_masked, c.product_type, c.product_name, c.order_amount, c.rate_bps, c.commission_amount, c.available_amount, c.locked_amount, c.withdrawn_amount, c.reversed_amount, c.debt_offset_amount, c.status, c.pay_time, c.refund_no, c.refund_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM distribution_commission c JOIN distribution_partner p ON p.partner_id = c.partner_id AND p.del_flag = '0' JOIN mobile_user pu ON pu.user_id = p.user_id AND pu.del_flag = '0' JOIN mobile_user ou ON ou.user_id = c.referred_user_id AND ou.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.commission_id = #{commissionId}

SELECT transaction_id, type, change_amount, available_after, locked_after, debt_after, biz_no, source_order_no, withdrawal_no, remark, create_time FROM distribution_account_transaction WHERE source_order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY transaction_id ASC

SELECT transaction_id, type, change_amount, available_after, locked_after, debt_after, biz_no, source_order_no, withdrawal_no, remark, create_time FROM distribution_account_transaction WHERE withdrawal_no = #{withdrawalNo} ORDER BY transaction_id ASC
mapper.sql: w.withdrawal_id, w.withdrawal_no, w.partner_id, p.partner_no, u.nick_name AS partner_name, CASE WHEN u.phone IS NULL OR u.phone = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(u.phone) <= 7 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4)) END AS phone_masked, w.apply_amount, w.method_type, w.payee_name, w.bank_name, w.bank_account_masked, (w.receipt_qr_file_key IS NOT NULL) AS receipt_available, w.status, w.reject_reason, CASE WHEN w.payment_reference IS NULL OR w.payment_reference = '' THEN '' WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(w.payment_reference) <= 8 THEN '****' ELSE CONCAT(LEFT(w.payment_reference, 4), '****', RIGHT(w.payment_reference, 4)) END AS payment_reference_masked, (w.payment_proof_file_key IS NOT NULL) AS payment_proof_available, w.apply_time, w.audit_time, w.paid_time, w.audit_by, w.pay_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM distribution_withdrawal w JOIN distribution_partner p ON p.partner_id = w.partner_id AND p.del_flag = '0' JOIN mobile_user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.withdrawal_id = #{withdrawalId}

SELECT p.partner_no, p.status, COALESCE(a.available_amount, 0) AS available_amount, COALESCE(a.withdraw_locked_amount, 0) AS locked_amount, COALESCE(a.total_withdrawn, 0) AS withdrawn_amount, COALESCE(a.debt_amount, 0) AS debt_amount, COALESCE(v.visit_count, 0) AS visit_count, COALESCE(r.promoted_user_count, 0) AS promoted_user_count, COALESCE(c.paid_user_count, 0) AS paid_user_count, COALESCE(c.valid_order_count, 0) AS valid_order_count, COALESCE(c.valid_order_amount, 0) AS valid_order_amount, COALESCE(c.valid_commission_amount, 0) AS total_commission_amount, cfg.min_withdraw_amount FROM distribution_partner p
JOIN distribution_config cfg ON cfg.config_id = 1 WHERE p.partner_id = #{partnerId} AND p.del_flag = '0'
